Class DemonicaRenderScope

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.compat.DemonicaRenderScope
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class DemonicaRenderScope extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Balances Avogadro draws with Demonica’s optional shared-context hooks. With no compatible GL state manager present the scope is inert; an installed but incompatible API fails during linking instead of silently drawing with an unbalanced state cache. Use try-with-resources on the rendering thread that opened the scope.

  • Method Details

    • open

      public static DemonicaRenderScope open()
      Begins a scope owned by the calling thread. Closing it twice is harmless.

    • close

      public void close()
      Ends this scope on its opening thread. Cross-thread closure is rejected before changing its closed state.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable

    • supportsLegacyPixelTransfer

      public static boolean supportsLegacyPixelTransfer()
      Reports whether legacy pixel-transfer state is available to a capture pass. Demonica replaces fixed-function pixel transfer and rejects the old reset calls.
      Returns:
      true for the native fixed-function backend, false for managed state

    • begin

      public static void begin()
      Calls the optional begin hook; explicit callers must pair it with end in a finally block.

    • end

      public static void end()
      Calls the optional end hook. Prefer an AutoCloseable scope when manual pairing is unnecessary.

    • synchronizeDrawBuffer

      public static void synchronizeDrawBuffer()
      Aligns Demonica's draw-buffer cache with the currently bound framebuffer before saving capture state. Framebuffer bindings retain their own draw selections; a cached selection from another framebuffer must not be replayed by the attribute stack. With no managed backend this does nothing.

    • deferWorldArtwork

      public static boolean deferWorldArtwork()
      Reports a main world pass whose final shader grading runs before RenderWorldLastEvent. Shadow passes keep their normal geometry; detached windows and ordinary rendering return false.
      Returns:
      whether full-bright artwork can be deferred until after world post-processing

    • shadowPass

      public static boolean shadowPass()
      Reports the optional shader loader's caster pass. A printed wall decal receives its support's shadows without inserting a second coplanar caster, which would shadow that same receiving plane.
      Returns:
      whether the current draw is building a shadow map

    • driverInteger

      public static int driverInteger(int parameter)
      Reads driver state when a managed backend may have a different cached value. Capture owners use this for pixel-transfer settings which must be restored exactly after readback.
      Parameters:
      parameter - OpenGL integer-state name
      Returns:
      the driver's current value

    • shaderPackName

      public static String shaderPackName()
      Returns the enabled shader pack's selected name for local presentation preferences. Empty means shaders are disabled or this provider does not expose its configuration; world rendering itself remains independent.
      Returns:
      enabled pack name, or an empty string

    • worldSurface

      public static void worldSurface(boolean textured, boolean lightmap)
      Selects the optional shader pass matching the texture and lightmap inputs of a world surface.
